hooks.command:
D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; echo '[repo-style] Style and report rules. Apply them to all prose, visible thinking, and end-of-turn reports in this session:'; for s in google-style action-first-replies work-report; do printf '
---

'; cat "$D/.claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md"; done; printf '
---

'; echo '[repo-tests] Testing rules from AGENTS.md. Apply them before you write, change, or delete a test:'; echo; T=$(awk '/^## /{if(p)exit; p=/^## [0-9. ]*Testing$/} p' "$D/AGENTS.md"); [ -n "$T" ] && printf '%s
' "$T" || echo 'AGENTS.md has no Testing section. Read AGENTS.md before you write, change, or delete a test.'
hooks.statusMessage: Loading repo style and test rules
